lines.zh: 深海太黑，我们靠侧线找路。
lines.en: The deep is black; we steer by lateral lines.

lines.zh: 二到八只，一列黑影压过海沟。
lines.en: Two to eight shadows, one column crossing the trench.

lines.zh: 在这里，骨头长得比肉快。
lines.en: Down here bone grows faster than flesh.

lines.zh: 跟上，掉队的会被深渊收走。
lines.en: Keep up; stragglers get taken by the abyss.

lines.zh: 我们游过的地方只剩骨粉味。
lines.en: Where we pass, only the smell of bone meal stays.

lines.zh: 冷流从鳃缝里直穿过去。
lines.en: Cold current runs straight through our gill slits.

lines.zh: 别抬头，上面一点光都没有。
lines.en: Don't look up; there is no light above.

lines.zh: 这条海沟我们游过上千遍。
lines.en: We have crossed this trench a thousand times.

lines.zh: 鳍贴着岩壁，能省点力气。
lines.en: Fins brushing the rock wall save us strength.
A demon's formation never breaks apart.

lines.zh: 深海巡游没有尽头，也没有早上。
lines.en: The deep patrol has no end and no morning.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，整群一起转向。
lines.en: One flick of the tail turns the whole school.

lines.zh: 水越深，我们的影子就越淡。
lines.en: The deeper we go, the fainter our shadows.

lines.zh: 又一群小鲱鱼跟在后头学游。
lines.en: Another brood of herring learns to swim behind us.

lines.zh: 骨头在水里发白，那是我们的路标。
lines.en: Pale bones in the water are our signposts.

lines.zh: 我们贴着海沟的壁，一路下潜。
lines.en: We follow the trench wall, diving deeper.
Hanging motionless in the dark water.

lines.zh: 鳃盖慢慢开合，像在数数。
lines.en: Gill covers open and close, slowly counting.

lines.zh: 深海没有白天，只有等待。
lines.en: No daylight in the deep, only waiting.
Let the current comb our scales.
Bone meal settles in our bellies; too lazy to move.

lines.zh: 我们漂着，像一块块黑石头。
lines.en: We drift like scattered black stones.

lines.zh: 头顶那层黑水一动不动。
lines.en: The black water overhead does not stir.
Even demons doze; keep quiet about it.

lines.zh: 水压压着脊背，倒挺舒服。
lines.en: Pressure weighs on our spines, and it feels good.

lines.zh: 偶尔有沉船的木头飘下来。
lines.en: Now and then a sunken ship's timber drifts past.

lines.zh: 谁都不先动，看谁忍不住。
lines.en: Nobody moves first; we wait for the twitch.
The whole school halts at one depth.
Hear that? The abyss is grinding its teeth.

lines.zh: 安静，是我们最擅长的本事。
lines.en: Silence is the thing we do best.
You came this deep; aren't you afraid?

lines.zh: 你那双眼睛在水里发白。
lines.en: Those eyes of yours look pale underwater.

lines.zh: 你身上带着骨头的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of bone.

lines.zh: 上面来的人总是先憋气。
lines.en: Surface folk always hold their breath first.

lines.zh: 我们绕你一圈，再作决定。
lines.en: We circle you once, then decide.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我们的牙不长眼。
lines.en: Don't reach out; our teeth don't aim well.
The trench edge lies right beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 深海里数我们，要数到八。
lines.en: Counting us down here takes you to eight.
A living human this deep is a rare guest.
Your lamp cannot pierce this layer of black.
It hurts, but the deep taught endurance.
Scales split; blood mixes into black water.
Who hit me? I can't see.
Don't think pain makes us flee.
A white mark stays on my bone.
The school scattered; regroup now.
Bone's intact; still biting.
Blood doesn't carry far down here.
The more it hurts, the meaner we get.
Now you've gotten me angry.
Fish scraps? Hand them over.

lines.zh: 血腥味一散开，整群都醒了。
lines.en: One whiff of blood wakes the whole school.

lines.zh: 我们不挑食，只挑新鲜的。
lines.en: We aren't picky, only after fresh meat.

lines.zh: 把肉按进水里，我就过来。
lines.en: Press that meat underwater and I'll come.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道也不错，凑合。
lines.en: Bone meal smells decent too, barely.
Your bait wobbles in the water; it's loud.

lines.zh: 二到八只，全盯着那块肉。
lines.en: Two to eight of us, all fixed on that meat.

lines.zh: 先来的先吃，这是深渊的规矩。
lines.en: First here eats first; abyss rules.
Don't tip the whole bucket in.
Starved long enough, we'd bite a shadow.
Bumped; my scales are out of line.
The trench is wide, yet you hit me.

lines.zh: 硬骨头顶回来，疼的是你。
lines.en: Hard bone pushes back; you'll feel it.
Don't shove; the formation is breaking.

lines.zh: 你踢起一团沉积物，看不清了。
lines.en: You kicked up silt; now nobody can see.
That one counts as a debt.

lines.zh: 我们的侧线比你耳朵灵。
lines.en: Our lateral lines hear better than your ears.

lines.zh: 撞散的骨粉够喂一片海。
lines.en: The bone meal you scattered could feed a sea.
Back away slowly; don't step on my tail.
Bump again and the school surrounds you.
Weddings in the deep have no light.
A brush of tails, and it's settled.

lines.zh: 我们把卵藏进岩缝最深处。
lines.en: We hide the eggs deep in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 骨质的鳞在黑暗里发亮。
lines.en: Bony scales glimmer faintly in the dark.
Don't crowd us; spawning needs quiet.
Once every two years; long enough a wait.
My mate swims steadier than I do.

lines.zh: 深渊会替我们看护幼鱼。
lines.en: The abyss will watch over the fry.
The water is just right this spawning season.

lines.zh: 以后这群会多出几十条黑影。
lines.en: Soon this school gains dozens more shadows.
A bucket? Deep fish aren't used to that.
The bucket water is warm; my scales tighten.
At least there's bone beneath me to survive.

lines.zh: 你要把我带到有光的地方？
lines.en: Taking me somewhere with light?
The bucket walls are too smooth to climb.

lines.zh: 记住，我掉骨粉不是给你玩的。
lines.en: Remember, my bone meal isn't a toy.

lines.zh: 八只里就我被捞出来了。
lines.en: Out of eight, I'm the one netted.
It sloshes hard; the water's gone cloudy.

lines.zh: 放我回海沟，那里才够黑。
lines.en: Put me back in the trench, where it's black.

lines.zh: 桶里没有水压，浑身不自在。
lines.en: No pressure in here; I feel wrong all over.
Something's moving; not a fish.

lines.zh: 血腥味顺着冷流冲上来了。
lines.en: Blood smell rides up the cold current.
All turn together, closing in slowly.
That shadow is bigger than us.
Bone forward; let's test our teeth.
Whoever charges first eats first.
My lateral line shakes; those are footsteps.
Don't let it leave this trench.
Once a demon stares, you don't leave.
Half circle, cut off the retreat.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在深水里传得很远。
lines.en: Your heartbeat carries far through the deep.
One more step and you're inside the ring.

lines.zh: 八双眼睛，全在黑暗里发光。
lines.en: Eight pairs of eyes glowing in the dark.

lines.zh: 海沟里只剩你一个活物。
lines.en: You're the only living thing in this trench.
Eight black shadows circle around you.
Your lamp just caught my teeth.
Don't turn; we're behind you too.
The abyss taught us how to wait.

lines.zh: 深渊把我们往前推了半尺。
lines.en: The abyss pushes us forward half a pace.
Decided; it happens now.
Bite down and you won't pull free.
The bony jaw strikes first.
One bite and the water turns red.
We never fight alone; all at once.
Scales rake your skin like sandpaper.
Does it hurt? The deep hurts worse.

lines.zh: 这一口是为了那群幼鱼。
lines.en: This bite is for the fry.
Don't swing; the water slows you.
The tail slap lands heavier than the bite.

lines.zh: 咬完就散，这是深渊的规矩。
lines.en: Bite, then scatter; abyss rules.

lines.zh: 又是一群，从海沟底上来。
lines.en: Another school rises from the trench floor.

lines.zh: 黑暗里凭空多出八道影子。
lines.en: Eight shadows appear out of the dark.
Birth in the deep makes no sound.
We wake smelling of bone meal.

lines.zh: 二到八只，从来不多不少。
lines.en: Two to eight, never more, never less.
Pressure bleaches the new scales white.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼，先找带骨味的同伴。
lines.en: Newly awake, I hunt for bone-scented kin.
That layer of black water is moving.

lines.zh: 恶魔的名号，出生就带着。
lines.en: The demon name comes with birth.
The abyss gained a few more mouths.
There's firelight down in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 从水面摔下来，鳞都散了。
lines.en: Falling from the surface knocks my scales loose.
Fish can drown too; don't laugh.
The blast flipped the whole school over.
That arrow drifted off course underwater.
Magic tingles strangely through the water.
Starve long enough and only bone remains.
Lightning hit the sea; everything went white.

lines.zh: 掉出世界，连深渊都没了。
lines.en: Out of the world, even the abyss is gone.
